path.description: The file, relative to the project root, POSIX-spelled. For a deletion, the path that was deleted

status.description: What happened to it since the merge base of `<ref>` and HEAD (`--base <ref>`). A move is "renamed" whether or not it was `git add`ed; a copy is "added". A rename crossing the root's boundary is reported as seen from inside the root: renamed in is "added", renamed out is "deleted". A file removed from the index but unchanged on disk is no row

oldPath.description: Where a "renamed" file came from, relative to the project root; NULL for every other status

similarity.description: git's similarity score (0-100) for a "renamed" file; NULL for every other status

projection-changed-files.description: A row of the derived `changed_files` relation
